text:
zoe: Quick thread on the accordion-style left rail + mobile collapse behavior. I built a small prototype where group rows act like accordions on desktop and full-screen drawers on mobile. Found a few weird deep-link/permalink behaviors we should decide on before implementation.

zoe: Symptom: permalink to an item (eg /w/alpha/insights/12/overview) opens the mobile drawer but the visual focus is on the group header. the item is visible but not keyboard-focused.

marcus: Repro'd on iPhone width. Desktop repro: open link, group expands, highlight goes to the top group row. resolver seems to match prefix-first.

leigh: Root cause: nav index keys are normalized but matching prefers parent slug when group header has same canonical prefix. For accordions we need to resolve the exact child so that focus + aria-current target the child.

ara: Proposal: matching order should be exactFullPath -> paramMatch -> aliasRedirects -> prefixFallback. Also introduce a mobileRenderMode flag so the same resolver triggers focus behavior appropriate for drawer vs persistent rail.

zoe: Important mobile nuance: when opening a drawer from an external permalink, we should animate open but not steal focus away from screen reader readout. Instead set focus to the child link and announce via a short live region: "Opened Insights > MRR overview". On iOS VoiceOver it reads better if focus lands after the animation completes.

marcus: For desktop, canonicalization: do history.replaceState(resolved) to keep shared links neat. For mobile, prefer to push the original so Back takes user to the originating external link (email). suggestion: push original then replace with resolved, like: history.pushState({orig}, '', orig); history.replaceState({}, '', resolved);

leigh: We should only show a small inline helper when resolved !== requested AND user has access to requested. Copy suggestion: "Showing a close match — Open original" (CTA). Keep it non-modal and store dismissed state in sessionStorage per orig path.

ara: Accessibility checklist: set aria-current="page" on the resolved child; set aria-expanded on the group toggle; use role="status" and aria-live="polite" for the helper; ensure focus order: 1) expand group, 2) focus child link, 3) announce via live region. That ordering avoids missed announcements.

zoe: Animation nuance: add small fade-in on the child highlight only when it was revealed by expansion. Respect reduced-motion preference.

marcus: Dev question: where to keep alias map? lean toward nav manifest in UI repo with controlled runtime refresh. allow ops to register server-side temporary redirects for big migrations. unit tests for ambiguous slugs needed.

leigh: Normalizer rules in the prototype: strip hash anchors -> remove trailing slashes -> decode percent encoding -> stable-sort query params except tokens. map hash->?anchor for consistent server logs. small pseudocode included in figma notes.

ara: History/popstate edgecases: ensure popstate doesn't re-resolve and show banner repeatedly. on popstate, if state.orig present then navigate to state.orig without re-showing banner; otherwise resolve normally. add unit tests for push/replace/pop flows.

marcus: Analytics: emit events resolved_from, resolved_to, banner_shown, banner_dismissed, open_original_clicked. helpful to decide which aliases need real redirects.

zoe: Mobile-specific: drawer deep-links should expand and auto-scroll to child and reveal context rows. if the item is nested >2 levels, consider temporarily pinning the drawer so it doesn't dismiss on outside tap immediately. but keep escape/cancel behaviors consistent.

leigh: UX question: should permalinks to group headers still be allowed? e.g., /w/alpha/insights should highlight group and show overview. yes, but exact child paths should win where present.

ara: Implementation plan: 1) change resolver order in nav-registry; 2) add canonicalize step with push+replace pattern; 3) add a11y focus + live-region helpers; 4) add small banner component with session dismiss; 5) add unit tests for slug collisions and history flows.

nav-bot: Preview build: https://console-preview.redwood/nav/accordion-drawer-proto (ephemeral)

zoe: Action items: @marcus update resolver PR + add history tests; @leigh add animation details + reduced-motion variant; @ara write aria snippets and paste them in the PR; zoe will upload mobile + desktop frames and small copy variations for the helper. meeting tomorrow 11:15 to validate with QE/PM.

marcus: I'll also add telemetry hooks and a tiny feature-flag so we can flip behaviour for mobile only.

leigh: I'll draft a short QA matrix for keyboard + screen reader + mobile gestures.

ara: I'll paste the ARIA snippets here later for devs to copy/paste. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
